_comment_vca: vca_load_job / vca_claimed_address_text are OPTIONAL ACCELERATORS, not missing criticals. They live in supabase/migrations_archive/20260514100500_vca_helper_rpcs.sql, and generate-vca/index.ts handles their absence explicitly — 'If the RPC isn't installed yet, fall back to a single-query view-style fetch' (index.ts:424) — so the function is correct with or without them. Allowlisted with that justification rather than restored, because promoting archived SQL into canonical migrations without a Postgres to run it against is the riskier move. OWNER DECISION PENDING: either restore them from the archive and delete these two entries, or delete the dead .rpc() calls and keep only the fallback.
